criteria.name: Problem relevance

concern.text: The submission does not provide convincing real-world user validation. There is no evidence of interviews, deployment observations, real incident datasets, controlled customer testing, or measured prevalence from an actual MFS.

built: Measured prevalence from public sources: 81,423 fraud cases in 2025 with MFS taking Tk 813 million and only 8.7% recovered (Bangladesh Bank data via The Financial Express); 6.3% of MFS users defrauded, 42% via call or SMS (TIB survey, n = 1,784).

A public labelled message dataset we did not create: AI-2 tested on 10,267 Bangla SMS/Telegram messages (BTTC, CC BY 4.0), including the honest zero-shot gap and pilot results with real labels. These are not verified upay fraud incidents.
Anonymous user-study tool for participants' own phones (Pause comprehension, stated stop rate, 'not sure' understanding, analyst triage A/B); results remain pending until people participate.

criteria.name: AI/ML depth

concern.text: Add repeated independently generated worlds, distribution-shift tests and real-data shadow evaluation; the 42.1% recall on the unseen QR disguise family shows generalisation remains imperfect.

built: AI-1 re-evaluated on five independently generated worlds and six distribution shifts, unchanged and retrained.
Leave-one-scam-family-out: recall on scam types the model never saw.
QR Shield on the unseen disguise: recall rises from 42% to 58% after analysts confirm 10 examples, with weekly precision unchanged.
Real-data evaluation of AI-2 on 10,267 real Bangla messages, and a shadow-mode replay of the test window through the production stack.

criteria.name: Business impact

concern.text: Customer money actually saved depends on an assumed 30–70% intervention rate. Validate false-pause cost, confirmed scams prevented, analyst minutes saved, agent service availability and net economic benefit.

built: An economic model that solves for the break-even follow rate instead of assuming one, with every assumption stated as low / base / high.
False-pause cost, 'not sure' review cost, analyst time and servers priced explicitly; net benefit per 1 million transfers and a sensitivity analysis.
Agent service measured by replaying every real cash-out request of the test days: customers served instead of turned away.
Follow-rate evidence from published warning studies, and the stated stop rate from our on-site study.

criteria.name: Prototype quality

concern.text: Strengthen runtime validation with concurrent-load, failure-recovery and stale-artifact tests, especially because the public demo can operate in recorded-response mode when the live API is unavailable.

built: Stale-artifact protection: every model file is checked against its SHA-256 at start; a stale or tampered model is never served and readiness says which file.
Failure-recovery test: the API is killed and the supervisor brings it back; restart time measured.
Concurrent-load tests with p50/p95/p99 latency on the monolith and on the scaled stack.
A closed loop across components (Case Linker findings protect the next victims), measured end to end.

criteria.name: Innovation

concern.text: Run ablations such as Pause Check only → Pause + QR Shield → Pause + QR + Case Linker, and quantify whether linking and evidence generation actually improve analyst decisions beyond simple alert aggregation.

built: An ablation ladder on the same transfers: rule → Pause Check → Pause Check with Case Linker feedback.
Case Linker against simple alert aggregation on the same 377 alerts: items, scam alerts in the top cases, mule wallets and cash-outs found.
QR Shield inside the chain: share of scam QR cash-outs that pass through flagged shops.
An analyst triage A/B (alert list vs linked cases) in the on-site study: accuracy and time.

criteria.name: Scalability & integration

concern.text: There is no distributed queue/event stream, shared cache, persistent transactional database, model-serving fleet, centralized monitoring, or demonstrated horizontal scaling.

built: A production-path stack: Redis Streams event bus, streaming feature worker with a shared online feature store, Postgres for decisions and audit, a fleet of small scoring replicas behind a load balancer, Prometheus monitoring.

Measured p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput under concurrent load with 1, 2 and 4 scorers. Two improved throughput at the tested 32-client load; four slowed down on the same laptop because resources were shared.
Training-serving parity test (streaming vs batch features), drift monitoring (PSI) with a retrain-and-approve policy, and the model registry.

criteria.name: Responsible AI & security

concern.text: Strengthen production governance with key rotation/secrets management, immutable audit storage, adversarial testing, explicit model rollback/version approval and real-data fairness validation.

built: JWT key ring with key ids and rotation; secrets only from the environment or a file outside the repository.
Tamper-evident audit log: hash-chained, append-only, with a verify endpoint that names the first altered row.
Model registry with approval and rollback; unapproved or altered models are not served.
Adversarial testing: disguised scam text and disguised prompt injection, with a defence now live; PII removed before any text reaches the LLM.
Fairness: the tenure gap in missed scams, an equal-opportunity fix and a policy dial that shows its cost.

Real-data fairness on 10,267 real Bangla messages: we found a channel bias synthetic data could not show (SMS scams caught 30% vs Telegram 97%) and fixed it with group-balanced training and per-channel thresholds (90% vs 90%), with the cost in false flags shown.
